title: `declared_tasks` cannot be checked byte-for-byte against CLI (no `--declared-tasks` flag)
what: The CLI has no `--declared-tasks` flag, so `declared_tasks` cannot be checked byte-for-byte against the CLI (C04).
why: DECISIONS.md E3 Node client decisions: the CLI lacks the flag.
impact: C04 cannot be validated end-to-end through the CLI.
workaround: Add a `--declared-tasks` CLI flag to close the gap.
